_comment: Tier 1 — industry & regulatory RSS registry. This file is now the actual source of truth: build-workflow.mjs reads it directly and generates the 'Load RSS Sources' Code node body from it (see the @data directive in newsletter/n8n/node-code/load-rss-sources.js). Editing this file and rebuilding is sufficient; there is no separate array to keep in sync anymore. 2026-09-24: two sme_commercial sources added (FSB UK site: query, unaudited; Business/Commercial Banking topic query) after a 2026-09 edition with zero SME/Commercial stories.
schema_notes: fetch.method is 'direct' (the publisher's own feed) or 'google_news' (a news.google.com/rss/search fallback, built from fetch.query with 'when:7d' appended at build time). status: working | quarantined — quarantined sources are excluded from the build entirely (not just skipped at runtime), so removing a dead source is a one-line status flip, not a deletion. cap bounds how many in-window items one source can contribute to the pool, so a high-volume feed cannot crowd out the rest of the branch. window_days overrides the default 7-day cutoff for sources that are real but naturally sparse (weekly regulatory press cadences), so a quiet week is not mistaken for a dead feed.
audit_method: Live curl against every URL below with the workflow's own User-Agent, plus a browser User-Agent as a second attempt before concluding a block is WAF-level rather than UA-level. See notes per source.

sources.name: American Banker
sources.notes: FIX: the registry's old URL (…/feed, no query string) 200s but serves the HTML section page, not RSS — Normalize was silently getting zero items from a 'working' source. ?rss=true returns real RSS 2.0; verified 10 items in-window.

sources.name: Banking Dive
sources.notes: Confirmed working; contributed 10 items in the last measured pool.

sources.name: Call Centre Helper
sources.notes: Confirmed working. Primary Digital Assist / EX source.

sources.name: Finextra
sources.notes: Direct feed answers every request — UA and browser UA alike — with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge page (HTTP 200, HTML body). This is a WAF wall, not a missing header, so no amount of retry/UA tuning fixes it. Falls back to Google News site:finextra.com, verified 100 in-window items same day. direct.url kept for the audit trail and in case Finextra's WAF policy changes; fetch.method decides which one the loader actually emits.

sources.name: The Financial Brand
sources.notes: Same Cloudflare wall as Finextra. Google News fallback verified. The old registry's separate 'Digital Banking Report' entry (thefinancialbrand.com/digital-banking/feed/) is the same publisher behind the same WAF and would resolve to the same site: query, so it is retired rather than duplicated — see removed_from_v2.

sources.name: FinTech Futures
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall, confirmed with UA and browser UA. Google News fallback verified: 100 in-window items.

sources.name: Bank Automation News
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall on direct. site:bankautomationnews.com returns 0 in Google's index (small publisher, thin indexing) even outside the 7d window; a quoted-title query surfaces syndicated mentions instead. window_days widened to 14 because this query is naturally low-volume, not broken — cross-run dedup means widening the window costs nothing beyond an occasional slow week.

sources.name: PaymentsSource
sources.notes: Direct feed 200s with an empty body (dead, not blocked). site:paymentssource.com also returns 0 — the publisher appears effectively de-indexed from Google News, not just this query. Falls back to a topic query instead of a site: filter so the LOB still gets covered from other payments-press coverage; expect a lower-precision mix here than the other fallbacks.

sources.name: Independent Banker
sources.notes: Direct feed 404s (WordPress feed removed/moved). Google News fallback verified: 11 in-window items. window_days widened to 14 for the same low-volume reason as Bank Automation News.

sources.name: NFIB News
sources.notes: Direct feed blocked (403, UA and browser UA both). Google News fallback verified: 39 in-window items.

sources.name: Small Business Trends
sources.notes: Confirmed working; contributed 10 items in the last measured pool.

sources.name: Bankrate News
sources.notes: Direct feed 404s (HTML, not RSS). Google News fallback verified: 49 in-window items.

sources.name: NerdWallet Banking
sources.notes: FIX: the old /blog/banking/rss/ path redirects to an HTML section page. /blog/feed/ is the real WordPress feed and is broader than 'banking' alone (savings, mortgages, credit cards), but that content is squarely retail-LOB and the cap keeps it from crowding the branch. Verified 10 in-window items, all on-topic.

sources.name: Credit Union Times
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall on direct (UA and browser UA). Google News fallback verified: 29 in-window items.

sources.name: Wealth Management Magazine
sources.notes: Confirmed working, and the highest-volume RSS source by a wide margin (41 of 73 RSS items in one measured pool). cap=15 (down from unbounded) so it cannot single-handedly define the branch's LOB mix.

sources.name: Financial Advisor Magazine
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall on direct. Google News fallback verified: 100 in-window items.

sources.name: Advisor Perspectives
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall on direct. Google News fallback verified: 57 in-window items.

sources.name: InvestmentNews
sources.notes: FIX: the old /feeds/news path 404s. /rss is the real Atom feed. Verified 77 in-window entries.

sources.name: ThinkAdvisor
sources.notes: Cloudflare wall on direct. Google News fallback verified: 32 in-window items.

sources.name: CX Network
sources.notes: FIX: the old /rss/ path serves the section hub page (HTML), not a feed. /rss/articles is the real feed. Verified 12 in-window items.

sources.name: CCW Digital
sources.notes: FIX: the old /rss/ path 404s. /rss/articles is the real feed. Verified 12 in-window items.

sources.name: Zendesk Blog
sources.notes: Direct feed redirects to an HTML blog index (the feed was retired). Google News fallback verified: 33 in-window items. cap kept low — this is a vendor blog, lower priority than the trade press above it.

sources.name: Reuters Banking
sources.notes: Direct Arc outbound-feed endpoint 404s (Reuters retired it). Google News fallback verified: 100 in-window items — capped hard because the query is wide (all Reuters banking coverage, not a specific vertical).

sources.name: Federal Reserve — Monetary Policy Press Releases
sources.notes: Feed itself works, but FOMC-cadence releases mean a plain 7-day window can land on zero real weeks — measured newest item 13 days old on one audit pass. window_days=14 avoids logging a live, correctly-fetched feed as 'empty' just because monetary policy did not make news that particular week; cross-run dedup means the wider window never re-surfaces an already-seen release.

sources.name: Federal Reserve — Banking Regulation Press Releases
sources.notes: Same sparse-cadence reasoning as the monetary feed. More relevant to product/compliance angles than monetary policy.

sources.name: OCC News Releases
sources.notes: FIX: the old /rss/news-releases.xml path 404s. occ_news.xml is the real feed. Verified 10 in-window items.

sources.name: FDIC News
sources.notes: FIX: the old /rss/news.xml path 404s — the FDIC retired its own RSS endpoint in favor of GovDelivery. Verified live: 'FDIC Press Releases' feed title, newest item dated the audit day, 25 items. Article links resolve to content.govdelivery.com, a different host than the feed itself — this is exactly why source identity now travels with the item from Load RSS Sources rather than being guessed from the article host.

sources.name: European Central Bank — Press
sources.notes: Confirmed working; low weekly volume, same sparse-cadence window as the other regulators.

sources.name: Federation of Small Businesses (FSB)
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-24 (Jarno / SME & Commercial coverage patch). UK small-business advocacy body — the closest UK/EU equivalent to NFIB, which is currently the only non-US-adjacent sme_commercial source and is itself US-only. NOT audited against this registry's own live-curl standard yet — verify the site: query returns real in-window items before treating this as a proven source, same as every other entry here was audited.

sources.name: Business/Commercial Banking (Google News topic)

fetch.query: ("business banking" OR "commercial banking" OR "SME banking") technology

sources.notes: Added 2026-09-24 (Jarno / SME & Commercial coverage patch). Topic query, not a site: filter — same pattern as PaymentsSource's fallback. Purpose is to stamp sme_commercial directly onto UK/EU/APAC commercial-banking product stories that the existing four US-only sources miss, including ones the cross_cutting feeds (Finextra, Banking Dive, American Banker) already fetch but don't tag for this LOB. De-duplicate Articles unions lob_tags on merge, so overlap with those feeds adds the tag rather than wasting the fetch. Expect lower precision than a site: query — same trade-off PaymentsSource already accepts.

removed_from_v2.reason: Very low weekly volume, mostly research papers not news; folds into monthly deep-dive instead of weekly.

removed_from_v2.name: Financial Stability Board

removed_from_v2.name: Entrepreneur Finance / Inc.com Finance

removed_from_v2.reason: Sept 2026 audit: same publisher and same Cloudflare wall as The Financial Brand (thefinancialbrand.com/digital-banking/feed/ vs /feed/); a second source_key would just resolve to the identical site:thefinancialbrand.com Google News fallback and double-count the same coverage.
